description: This file contains functions and types for integrating Microsoft Teams messaging, including message rendering, activity building, and message sending with retry logic, handling media uploads, and conversation reference management.

classes.name: MSTeamsConversationReference
classes.description: Represents a reference to a Microsoft Teams conversation, including activity ID, user, agent, conversation details, channel ID, service URL, and locale.

classes.name: MSTeamsAdapter
classes.description: Defines methods for continuing conversations, processing requests, updating, and deleting activities within MS Teams.

classes.name: MSTeamsReplyRenderOptions
classes.description: Options for rendering reply payloads into MS Teams messages, including text chunking, media mode, table mode, and chunk mode.

classes.name: MSTeamsRenderedMessage
classes.description: Represents a message to be sent to MS Teams, with optional text and media URL.

classes.name: MSTeamsSendRetryOptions
classes.description: Configuration for retrying message sends, including max attempts, base delay, and max delay.

classes.name: MSTeamsSendRetryEvent
classes.description: Event data for retry attempts, including message index, count, delay, classification, and max attempts.

methods.name: buildConversationReference
methods.description: Constructs a MSTeamsConversationReference object from a stored conversation reference, validating required fields.

methods.name: renderReplyPayloadsToMessages
methods.description: Converts reply payloads into an array of MSTeamsRenderedMessage objects, handling text chunking and media modes.

methods.name: buildActivity
methods.description: Creates a Teams activity object from a rendered message, handling media uploads, mentions, and attachments.

methods.name: sendMSTeamsMessages
methods.description: Sends a batch of messages to MS Teams with support for retries, threading, and proactive messaging, returning message IDs.
